tv_trade_league_create_effect = {
	save_scope_as = tv_trade_league_founder
	if = {
		limit = {
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = TV_HAS_VARIABLE_NOT_SET_TT
				NOT = { has_variable = tv_trade_league_member }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_league_member value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				any_international_organizations_member_of = {
					international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
					leader_country ?= scope:tv_trade_league_founder
				}
			}
		}
		create_international_organization = {
			type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_to_international_organization = prev
				set_leader_country = prev
			}
		}
	}
}

tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_demand_horses_effect = {
	save_scope_as = tv_trade_monopoly_leader
	var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_horses ?= {
		market = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_temporary_demand = demand:tv_trade_virtual_demand_horses } }
				add_temporary_demand = { type = demand:tv_trade_virtual_demand_horses scale = { value = scope:tv_trade_monopoly_leader.var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_horses } months = -1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

	var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_chili ?= {
		market = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_temporary_demand = demand:tv_trade_virtual_demand_chili } }
				add_temporary_demand = { type = demand:tv_trade_virtual_demand_chili scale = { value = scope:tv_trade_monopoly_leader.var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_chili } months = -1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_demand_chili_effect = {
	var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_chili ?= {
		market = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_temporary_demand = demand:tv_trade_virtual_demand_chili }
				remove_temporary_demand = demand:tv_trade_virtual_demand_chili
			}
		}
	}
}

tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_supply_chili_effect = {
	save_scope_as = tv_trade_monopoly_leader
	var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_location_chili ?= {
		market = {
			add_goods_supply = { goods = goods:chili amount = { value = scope:tv_trade_monopoly_leader.var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_chili } }
		}
		scope:tv_trade_monopoly_leader = {
			set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_applied_chili value = 1 }
		}
	}
}

tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_supply_chili_effect = {
	save_scope_as = tv_trade_monopoly_leader
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_applied_chili ?= { this >= 1 } }
		var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_location_chili ?= {
			market = {
				add_goods_supply = { goods = goods:chili amount = { value = scope:tv_trade_monopoly_leader.var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_chili multiply = -1 } }
			}
			scope:tv_trade_monopoly_leader = {
				set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_applied_chili value = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
}

tv_trade_league_recalculate_action_accounting_horses_effect = {
	hidden_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_horses value = { value = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_horses divide = 5 } }
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_horses value = { value = var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_horses divide = 5 } }

	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_horses value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_horses >= 1 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_horses add = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_horses }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_horses >= 1 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_horses add = var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_horses }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_embargo_active_horses >= 1 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_used_pct_horses value = 30 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_horses add = 30 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_horses value = var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_horses }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_horses subtract = var:tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_horses }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_horses < 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_horses value = 0 }
	}

	}
}

tv_trade_league_refresh_monopoly_page_limits_effect = {
	hidden_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_trade_selected_monopoly_category } }
			set_variable = { name = tv_trade_selected_monopoly_category value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_trade_selected_monopoly_page } }
			set_variable = { name = tv_trade_selected_monopoly_page value = 1 }
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_selected_monopoly_page_max value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_selected_monopoly_category ?= 1 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_trade_selected_monopoly_page_max value = 2 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_selected_monopoly_category ?= 2 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_trade_selected_monopoly_page_max value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_selected_monopoly_category ?= 3 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_trade_selected_monopoly_page_max value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_selected_monopoly_category ?= 4 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_trade_selected_monopoly_page_max value = 2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_selected_monopoly_page < 1 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_trade_selected_monopoly_page value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_selected_monopoly_page > var:tv_trade_selected_monopoly_page_max }
			set_variable = { name = tv_trade_selected_monopoly_page value = var:tv_trade_selected_monopoly_page_max }
		}
	}
}

tv_trade_league_select_first_displayed_monopoly_good_effect = {
	hidden_effect = {
		tv_trade_league_refresh_monopoly_page_limits_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:tv_trade_selected_monopoly_category ?= 1
				var:tv_trade_selected_monopoly_page ?= 1
			}
			set_variable = { name = tv_trade_selected_good value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				var:tv_trade_selected_monopoly_category ?= 1
				var:tv_trade_selected_monopoly_page ?= 2
			}
			set_variable = { name = tv_trade_selected_good value = 29 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				var:tv_trade_selected_monopoly_category ?= 2
				var:tv_trade_selected_monopoly_page ?= 1
			}
			set_variable = { name = tv_trade_selected_good value = 61 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				var:tv_trade_selected_monopoly_category ?= 3
				var:tv_trade_selected_monopoly_page ?= 1
			}
			set_variable = { name = tv_trade_selected_good value = 42 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				var:tv_trade_selected_monopoly_category ?= 4
				var:tv_trade_selected_monopoly_page ?= 1
			}
			set_variable = { name = tv_trade_selected_good value = 7 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				var:tv_trade_selected_monopoly_category ?= 4
				var:tv_trade_selected_monopoly_page ?= 2
			}
			set_variable = { name = tv_trade_selected_good value = 34 }
		}
		tv_trade_league_refresh_selected_good_projection_effect = yes
	}
}

tv_trade_league_refresh_selected_good_projection_effect = {
	hidden_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_trade_selected_good } }
			set_variable = { name = tv_trade_selected_good value = 1 }
		}
		remove_variable = tv_trade_selected_good_scope

tv_trade_league_country_monthly_pulse_effect = {
	hidden_effect = {
		save_scope_as = tv_trade_league_pulse_country
		every_international_organizations_member_of = {
			limit = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:tv_trade_league_pulse_country
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					international_organization_has_leader = yes
					leader_country ?= {
						custom_tooltip = {
							text = TV_HAS_GRAND_MERCHANT_CHAR_TT
							has_variable = tv_grand_merchant_char
						}
						var:tv_grand_merchant_char ?= { is_alive = yes }
						tv_grand_merchant_available_for_monopoly_trigger = yes
					}
				}
				tv_trade_league_update_monopolies_effect = yes
			}
			else = {
				leader_country ?= {
					tv_trade_league_suspend_virtual_demands_effect = yes
					tv_trade_league_suspend_virtual_supplies_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					var:tv_trade_market_candidate_score > 0
					var:tv_trade_market_candidate_score > var:tv_trade_origin_score_2_horses
				}
				set_variable = { name = tv_trade_origin_score_3_horses value = var:tv_trade_origin_score_2_horses }
				set_variable = { name = tv_trade_origin_local_production_3_horses value = var:tv_trade_origin_local_production_2_horses }
				set_variable = { name = tv_trade_origin_local_demand_3_horses value = var:tv_trade_origin_local_demand_2_horses }

				if = {
					limit = { has_variable = tv_trade_origin_market_2_horses }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_origin_market_3_horses value = var:tv_trade_origin_market_2_horses }
				}
				set_variable = { name = tv_trade_origin_market_2_horses value = scope:tv_trade_candidate_market_location }

	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_node_control_pct_slaves_goods add = var:tv_trade_node_control_pct_2_slaves_goods }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_node_control_pct_slaves_goods add = var:tv_trade_node_control_pct_3_slaves_goods }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_node_control_pct_slaves_goods divide = 3 }
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_consumer_control_pct_slaves_goods value = 0 }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_consumer_control_pct_slaves_goods add = var:tv_trade_consumer_control_pct_1_slaves_goods }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_consumer_control_pct_slaves_goods add = var:tv_trade_consumer_control_pct_2_slaves_goods }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_consumer_control_pct_slaves_goods add = var:tv_trade_consumer_control_pct_3_slaves_goods }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_consumer_control_pct_slaves_goods divide = 3 }
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_slaves_goods value = var:tv_trade_origin_control_pct_slaves_goods }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_slaves_goods add = var:tv_trade_node_control_pct_slaves_goods }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_slaves_goods add = var:tv_trade_consumer_control_pct_slaves_goods }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_slaves_goods >= 100 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_slaves_goods value = 1 }
	}

	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_slaves_goods value = { value = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_slaves_goods divide = 5 } }
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_slaves_goods value = { value = var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_slaves_goods divide = 5 } }

	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_slaves_goods value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_slaves_goods >= 1 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_slaves_goods add = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_slaves_goods }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_slaves_goods >= 1 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_slaves_goods add = var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_slaves_goods }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_embargo_active_slaves_goods >= 1 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_used_pct_slaves_goods value = 30 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_slaves_goods add = 30 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_slaves_goods value = var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_slaves_goods }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_slaves_goods subtract = var:tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_slaves_goods }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_slaves_goods < 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_slaves_goods value = 0 }
	}

	if = {
		limit = {
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_slaves_goods >= 1
			var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_slaves_goods >= 1
		}
		tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_demand_slaves_goods_effect = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_monopoly_slaves_goods < 1
				var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_slaves_goods < 1
			}
		}
		tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_demand_slaves_goods_effect = yes
	}

	if = {
		limit = {
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_slaves_goods >= 1
			var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_slaves_goods >= 1
			NOT = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_applied_slaves_goods ?= { this >= 1 } }
		}
		tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_supply_slaves_goods_effect = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_monopoly_slaves_goods < 1
				var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_slaves_goods < 1
			}
		}
		tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_supply_slaves_goods_effect = yes
	}

	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_monopoly_slaves_goods >= 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_embargo_active_slaves_goods >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_embargo_country_slaves_goods ?= {
				save_scope_as = tv_trade_embargo_target
				scope:tv_trade_monopoly_leader.var:tv_trade_embargo_location_slaves_goods ?= {
					market = {
						add_merchant_power = {
							country = scope:tv_trade_embargo_target
							key = tv_trade_monopoly_embargo_slaves_goods
							months = 2
							power = merchant_power_severe_penalty
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

			tv_trade_league_refresh_monopoly_display_effect = yes
		}
	}
}
